extracted_clean_room_invariants.trapezoid_velocity_profile: Ease-in and ease-out ramp fractions prevent abrupt motion snaps on zoom and pan
extracted_clean_room_invariants.collision_free_hud_ownership: Explicit UI bounding-box avoidance relocates floating camera viewport when cursor/focus enters active target quadrant

schema_declarations.name: rea_agents
schema_declarations.sql:
CREATE TABLE rea_agents (
                agent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                agent_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(agent_role IN ('CLIENT', 'SUPPLIER', 'INTERNAL_ENTITY')),
                legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                commercial_name TEXT,
                country_code TEXT NOT NULL,
                jurisdiction_code TEXT NOT NULL,
                tax_id_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                tax_id_number TEXT NOT NULL,
                tax_id_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                default_currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
                email TEXT,
                address TEXT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

schema_declarations.name: rea_audit_versions
schema_declarations.sql:
CREATE TABLE rea_audit_versions (
                audit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                document_number TEXT NOT NULL,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                event_action TEXT NOT NULL,
                previous_status TEXT,
                new_status TEXT NOT NULL,
                snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                prev_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                current_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL
            )

schema_declarations.name: rea_invoices
schema_declarations.sql:
CREATE TABLE rea_invoices (
                invoice_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                document_number TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(document_type IN ('STANDARD_INVOICE', 'CREDIT_NOTE', 'RECTIFYING_INVOICE')),
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('BORRADOR', 'EMITIDO_APROBADO', 'RECTIFICADO_ANULADO')),
                version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                parent_invoice_id TEXT,
                issuer_agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                counterparty_agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                invoice_currency TEXT NOT NULL,
                functional_currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
                exchange_rate REAL NOT NULL,
                subtotal REAL NOT NULL,
                indirect_tax_total REAL NOT NULL,
                withholding_tax_total REAL NOT NULL,
                gross_total REAL NOT NULL,
                net_payable REAL NOT NULL,
                functional_net_payable REAL NOT NULL,
                lines_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                tax_breakdown_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                equivalencies_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                immutable_lock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                approved_at TEXT,
                FOREIGN KEY(issuer_agent_id) REFERENCES rea_agents(agent_id),
                FOREIGN KEY(counterparty_agent_id) REFERENCES rea_agents(agent_id)
            )

schema_declarations.name: rea_resources
schema_declarations.sql:
CREATE TABLE rea_resources (
                resource_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                sku TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                resource_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(resource_type IN ('SERVICE', 'DIGITAL_ASSET', 'HARDWARE')),
                unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
                currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

clean_room_erp_specifications.entity_model: Actors/Counterparties (Clients & Suppliers) with jurisdiction-bound Tax ID validation (US EIN, CO NIT Mod-11, CL RUT Mod-11, MX RFC)
clean_room_erp_specifications.hybrid_tax_engine: Real-time Multi-Currency FX selector (USD, COP, MXN, EUR) + US Sales Tax & LATAM IVA/ReteFuente/ReteIVA/ReteICA matrix
clean_room_erp_specifications.state_machine: Strict two-state lifecycle: BORRADOR (mutable, versioned) -> EMITIDO_APROBADO (immutable_lock=1, SHA-256 hash-chained)
clean_room_erp_specifications.rectification_flow: Direct mutation blocked on approved invoices; adjustments require linked CREDIT_NOTE or RECTIFYING_INVOICE

limitations: Read-only quiescent SQLite inspection via Node.js native DatabaseSync.
